purpose: Define the smallest deterministic builder contract before selecting or adding an Ops implementation package.

rule: Inputs remain source records; the builder does not decide accepted meaning.
Output is stable-sorted, source-linked, non-authority, and preserves unknown missing drift conflict orphan and retired states.

statement: Every observed active repository appears even when no packet or package record exists; missing knowledge becomes an explicit gap rather than omission.
All map graph and sequence views consume the same entity and relation IDs.
Reordering semantically identical input lines produces byte-identical output.
Duplicate IDs, dangling relation endpoints, mixed exact revisions, and contradictory current classifications are rejected.

reason: No selected existing Ops package or new implementation has yet produced the expected semantic JSONL from the fixture.
